notes: Crosschecked seven Valorous reward names against https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Spaulders_of_the_Wayward_Vanquisher and exact item IDs in current Retail Wowhead item pages. Current token right-click Use converts by class and loot specialization; historical Dalaran vendor redemption is distinct (Dubin Clay DK; Valerie Langrom rogue/druid; Paldesse mage). 10-man Valorous tier-8 list, not 25-man Conqueror's Mantle or 2026 Retail alternate name duplicates (e.g. 156124). WoWhead presently lists currency for 7; token source patch history may vary. No DE, cast numbers, price, or unverified extra variants.
